trails.name: Quilotoa Loop
trails.why: The Quilotoa Loop is a challenging 3-to-5-day hike in Ecuador that takes you through high Andean villages and past Laguna Quilotoa, a crater lake surrounded by volcanic peaks.

trails.name: Cotopaxi volcano summit
trails.why: Cotopaxi is an active stratovolcano in the Andes Mountains, located in the Latacunga canton of Cotopaxi Province, about 50 km south of Quito, and 33 km northeast of the city of Latacunga, Ecuador, in South America.

trails.name: Cayambe summit
trails.why: Third highest mountain in Ecuador but also in the northern hemisphere of the American continent.

trails.name: Antisana volcano summit
trails.why: Antisana is a large stratovolcano in the Andes, potentially active and covered by glaciers.

trails.name: Carihuairazo volcano summit
trails.why: Mount Carihuairazo is a volcanic caldera neighboured by Ecuador's highest mountain Chimborazo.

trails.name: Imbabura Volcano summit
trails.why: Imbabura is an inactive stratovolcano in northern Ecuador. Although it has not erupted for at least 14,000 years, it is not thought to be extinct.

trails.name: Sumaco summit
trails.why: Sumaco is a symmetrical, isolated stratovolcano, that is set off from the main Ecuador volcanic axis.

trails.name: Rumiñahui summit
trails.why: Rumiñahui is a dormant, heavily eroded stratovolcano 4,721 metres above sea level. Situated in the Andes mountains 40 km south of Quito, Ecuador, it is overshadowed by its famous neighbour Cotopaxi.
